title: Recurring mall dream
content: I keep dreaming of a mall that has a large parking garage attached to it. I often get lost there. The mall itself is huge and has a lot of brick bridges and a fountain. There’s a toy store in the mall I went to and there was a ‘tour’ or some kind of ‘walk through ride’ one time and I remember people getting hurt in there and I was afraid to go in. I often jump or climb or fly from the bridges. I see other people there and sometimes it’s people I know. A lot of large staircases and it’s decorated with red flowers in big flower pots. Anyone else seen this? I also get stuck or lost in bathrooms that have a lot of toilets with no doors on the stalls and a lot of them are very dirty
